title: Exact Controllability of Backward-Structured Mean-Field SDEs: Hautus Criteria and Initial-Time Dichotomy
summary: This paper studies exact controllability of linear mean-field stochastic differential equations with backward-structure. We establish Hautus criteria and uncover a sharp dichotomy between the zero initial time and positive initial times. At time zero, exact controllability is characterized by a Hautus condition for the mean dynamics, with additional control directions generated by the centered stochastic dynamics.
